entries.title: Reddit Comments
entries.description: Drops the sidebar, the vote arrows and the comment toolbars from a thread.

entries.title: Wikipedia Article
entries.description: Drops the navigation column, the page tools and the footer from an article.

entries.title: YCombinator News Comments
entries.description: Drops the orange bar, the vote arrows and the reply forms from a thread.

entries.title: Medium Article
entries.description: Drops the floating bars, the share widget and the footer from a post.

entries.title: Twitter
entries.description: Drops the top bar, the profile header and the tweet action rows.

entries.title: Hide Banners & Overlays
entries.description: Removes the consent dialogs, sign-in walls, app prompts and modal surveys that sit over a page, and undoes the scroll lock they leave behind. A page that puts its own content in a dialog loses it too.

entries.title: Hide Ads & Sponsored Content
entries.description: Removes the in-page ad slots and the sponsored blocks beside them. The ad frames themselves never reach a book - what this takes out is the native units, the promoted rows and the space held open for them.

entries.title: Hide Navigation
entries.description: Removes the site header, the menu bars and the breadcrumbs. A table of contents the page marked up as navigation goes with them.

entries.title: Hide Sidebars
entries.description: Removes the side rails and everything parked in them. An aside inside the article is kept, since that is where pull quotes and author notes live.

entries.title: Hide Footers
entries.description: Removes the site footer and the legal and corporate navigation in it. A footer inside the article is kept, since that is usually the byline and the licence.

entries.title: Hide Comments
entries.description: Removes the comment thread and the reply forms under an article. Worth switching off when the discussion is what is being saved.

entries.title: Hide Related & Recommended
entries.description: Removes the "more stories", "read next" and trending blocks, and the recommendation carousels wrapped around them.

entries.title: Hide Share Widgets
entries.description: Removes the share bars and social buttons that sit around and between the paragraphs.

entries.title: Hide Newsletter & Follow Prompts
entries.description: Removes the inline subscribe boxes, follow buttons and email capture forms an article is broken up by.

entries.title: Hide Embed Placeholders
entries.description: Removes what an embed leaves behind. The players and frames themselves are never written to a book, so what is left without this is an empty box, a "watch on" link, or the fallback text of a quoted post.

entries.title: Hide Paywall Walls & Fades
entries.description: Removes the subscribe wall under a truncated article and the gradient that fades the text into it. It does not unlock anything - what the page never loaded cannot be saved.

entries.title: Unstick Headers
entries.description: Stops sticky and floating bars from being pinned, so they are captured once at the top instead of over the text.

entries.title: Reveal Collapsed Content
entries.description: Opens what the page folded away. A closed disclosure or an inactive tab is hidden, and hidden text is not captured at all - so without this it is missing from the book rather than merely collapsed.

entries.title: Serif Reading
entries.description: A serif body face, a little larger, on looser lines.

entries.title: Sans Serif Reading
entries.description: The same, with a sans serif body face.

entries.title: Compact
entries.description: Smaller type on tighter lines, for fitting more of a long page on a page.

entries.title: Large Print
entries.description: Larger type and heavier spacing throughout.

entries.title: Force Light Background
entries.description: Dark text on a light page, whatever the page uses - a dark page is captured as dark, and prints as a black slab. Code blocks, quotations and callouts keep their own colours, so the highlighting in them survives.

entries.title: Text Only
entries.description: Leaves the pictures out, for a smaller file and a text-only read. The figures they sat in are kept, so captions and attribution stay.
